subject: Re: revised assets and delivery timing
text: Hi there, I hope your week’s going okay. I’m circling back from Tuesday’s note because I want to make sure the delivery window for the revised assets still works on your end. I can send the first draft by Thursday afternoon, if that helps your team line up the review before the weekend. If Thursday feels too tight, I can move it to Friday morning, though I’d appreciate a short heads-up before then so I can adjust my schedule. I’ve held a little extra time open to make small changes after the client comments, so it would be good to know whether they’d prefer edits in the file itself or as a separate note. Also, let me know if you need a different file format when it’s sent. I don’t want to add anything late if the production handoff is already prepared. Happy to hop on a quick call if that’s easier than typing it out. Either way, I’ll follow up tomorrow evening if I haven’t heard back, just so we don’t lose time.
